title: Age Calculator

basics.tagline: Precise Age in Years, Months & Days

listing.shortDescription: A precise, lightweight age calculator — enter a date of birth and get exact years, months and days instantly, with a clean interface.
listing.fullDescription: A small tool with a precise job. The Age Calculator takes a date of birth and returns the exact age broken into years, months and days — instantly, with validation for future dates and a clean, focused interface. Built with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, it loads instantly and runs anywhere.

cover.imageAlt: Age Calculator — Precise Age in Years, Months & Days

closing.conclusion: A small tool with a precise job — the age calculator answers instantly, breaking the result into years, months and days with a clean, usable interface.

challenge.summary: The requirement was absurdly simple and absurdly precise: give an exact age — years, months and days — with no ambiguity and no dependencies.

points.title: Precision
points.description: Age must be exact to the day, including months.

points.title: Validation
points.description: Future or impossible dates must be rejected.

points.title: Simplicity
points.description: One input, one button, one answer.

solution.summary: The answer is a single focused screen: pick a date, get an answer. Correct date arithmetic and clear validation make the tool trustworthy.

points.title: Correct arithmetic
points.description: Years, months and days computed exactly.

points.title: Edge cases handled
points.description: Validation covers future dates and bad input.
